design.6.1: Own binomial risk estimator: observed probability q=(1-b)p+b*c, E[estimate]=q, bias=q-p, variance=q(1-q)/n, MSE=variance+bias². Exact endpoint point masses; finite empirical repetition can differ from analytic distribution. Avoid mistaking a finite ratio-estimator bias for the chosen systematic shift.
design.6.2: Own binary E/Y full four-cell population followed by four separate participation probabilities s_ey. Selected OR equals original OR*s11*s00/(s10*s01) when cells/selection are positive. Both direction and cancellation are possible; include multiplicatively separable sampling as a no-association-change example. Empty selected strata and positivity failures stay undefined, never capped estimates.
design.6.3: Construct a single full population with latent baseline health, health-dependent employment and nonnegative authored occupational risk difference. General-population observed outcome includes employed people; do not use arbitrary unrelated populations. Compare crude employed/general and employed/nonemployed risks with standardized counterfactual risks at a common declared health mix. This is a known model, not identification from observed comparisons alone.
design.6.4: The frozen name needs explicit hypotheses: binary true exposure, nondifferential independent classification conditional on true exposure, nonempty groups, informative Se+Sp>1 and a common unconfounded target. Posterior risks are convex mixtures, so RR lies between1 and true RR for an informative classifier. Se+Sp=1 erases the association; below-chance classification can reverse it. This is not a general multicategory/outcome/confounded attenuation theorem.
design.6.5: Use outcome-specific exposure sensitivity/specificity to demonstrate differential recall in both directions. Keep actual exposure/outcome cells fixed and apply declared recording matrices; cases do not necessarily overreport every exposure. Preserving/erasing/reversing association depends on all four rates. Observational case-control OR is an association in this model, not automatically a causal RR.
design.6.8: Own synthetic aircraft geometry and explicitly invented damage, never original Wald holes or measurements. A Poisson hit-and-lethality model gives return probability exp(-sum(lambda_i*q_i)) and conditional nonfatal hits lambda_i*(1-q_i); sparse holes can also mean little incoming fire. Show full fleet and returning subset, known-input counterfactual armor comparison, and nonidentification from survivors alone. Zero hits, zero lethality, no observed survivors and rare positive probabilities need honest statuses.
